newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Tellabs to create 210 jobs in Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Tellabs to create 210 jobs in Ireland.

text.p: Ireland's Minister for Enterprise and Employment Richard Bruton said on Tuesday that Tellabs Ltd., the Irish unit of U.S. corporation Tellabs Inc., would create 210 new jobs at its Shannon facility.

Bruton said the 20 million Irish pounds investment, backed by the Shannon Development body, would involve the construction of a new 9,300 square metre (100,000 square feet) state-of-the-art facility at the company's Free Zone-based plant in County Clare in the west of Ireland.
"The majority of these jobs will be in the engineering and telecommunications disciplines," Bruton said in a statement.

Tellabs Ltd., which operates a complete research and development, manufacturing, marketing and service facility in the Shannon region, supplies a wide range of advanced network products to telecommunications service providers world-wide.
Annual turnover at Tellabs Ltd. was 869 million Irish pounds last year, up 37 percent from 1995. Tellabs Inc. employs 3000 employees in 19 countries worldwide. --Dublin newsroom 353-1-661-3377
